summary: Reinforce Core-first delivery and record pool policy and unified application catalogue direction without changing implementation priorities. API impact: none; planning and contributor guidance only.

guide.reason: No implemented operator workflow changes; future controls remain planned and must ship with verified guide instructions.

api.reason: No client endpoint, Controller operation, Core command or observed-result flow changes. Plans clarify future Controller-to-Core requests, Core-owned operations and inventory/adoption, with Swarm task scheduling; concrete contracts remain prerequisites of implementation slices.

roadmap.reason: Records future design direction and clarifies ownership without changing published milestone status, built/outstanding items or implementation order.

state.reason: Documentation only; no runtime state is introduced. Future policy and application records must live on the pool master and expose inventory/adoption, with Swarm retaining its runtime state and existing Controller exceptions preserved.

verification.method: Passed python3 scripts/check_docs.py --all, python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_repository_privacy.py (1 test), git diff --check, and scripts.check_docs.links for all three edited Markdown files. python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree reports missing assessments only for unrelated concurrent code and Windows lab-plan changes; this batch is covered. Independent read-only review found no blocking issues; its recommendation to explicitly gate interrupted provisioning and fresh-Controller application rediscovery was incorporated into Phase 10. Documentation-only review; no runtime, browser or lab tests apply and no new feature acceptance is claimed.
